plugins.NAME: AmiHASS
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Search Home Assistant entities, read states and confirm supported actions through the AmiHASS service.

plugins.NAME: Aminet Browser
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Search Aminet, read package details and readmes, and download archives with progress, speed and remaining-time feedback. Open downloads with your archive handler.

plugins.NAME: ARexx Runner
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Run named, configured ARexx macros through RexxMast.

plugins.NAME: Assigns and Volumes
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Explore volumes and assigns, check free disk space, and open drawers.

plugins.NAME: Calculator
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Calculate arithmetic and convert bytes, time, length, metric mass and C/F/K temperatures offline, without an FPU.

plugins.NAME: Clipboard Tools
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Read, copy, transform and save clipboard text, with optional searchable session history, expiry and explicit restore.

plugins.NAME: Clock
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Check the local time, with optional seconds.

plugins.NAME: Date Utilities
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Look up weekdays, calculate dates and work with timestamps.

plugins.NAME: Developer Tools
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Convert decimal and hexadecimal numbers, look up character codes, and inspect bit masks and Amiga protection flags.

plugins.NAME: DOpus
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Open drawers and reveal files in Directory Opus.

plugins.NAME: File Finder
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Search files and drawers across your configured directories.

plugins.NAME: Memory
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Check available Chip and Fast memory.

plugins.NAME: Music Controls
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Control HippoPlayer, AmigaAMP and EaglePlayer 2 through their ARexx ports.

plugins.NAME: Music Library
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Search music modules and send them to your configured player.

plugins.NAME: System Commands
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Check memory and system versions, flush unused libraries, and request confirmed restart or shutdown actions.

plugins.NAME: Task Manager
plugins.DESCRIPTION: List running processes and send an explicitly confirmed break signal to an exact process name.

plugins.NAME: WHDLoad
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Find and launch installed WHDLoad games.

plugins.NAME: Wikipedia
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Search Wikipedia and read article summaries in a native window.

plugins.NAME: Workbench Windows
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Find and bring forward open Workbench windows and public screens.

themes.name: Amber
themes.description: Warm amber on near-black, like an old terminal

themes.description: MagicWB-style greys with a blue selection
